versionInformation.promotionalText: Choose your controls. Move through your music with waveforms, loops, cues and effects in a workspace that adapts to your setup.
versionInformation.description:
GenErik DJ puts your music and the controls you use in one adaptable workspace. Mix on iPad, iPhone or Mac. Show the controls you need and leave more room for the waveforms.

YOUR SETUP
Show or hide Beat Jump, the tempo fader, Cue and headphone cue independently. Move the browser and deck dividers to make space for the task in front of you. Your choices stay saved between sessions.

DIRECT CONTROL
Load tracks, set loops and move through the music from the waveform. On a touch screen, use two fingers to move and resize a loop. Open EQ, filters and effects beside each deck, then close them to restore waveform space.

PREPARE YOUR MUSIC
Browse local songs and playlists. Inspect BPM, key, beat grids and track sections. Adjust beat one, save cues and review the next track before you load it. Tempo and key suggestions help you find compatible tracks.

MIX AND RECORD
Use Sync, loops, cues, EQ and effects across two decks. Record a mix, review its track history and share the saved recording. Connect a supported controller for hardware control. Available controls vary by model. See the controller catalogue at https://dj.generik.au/controllers.

PRIVATE PREPARATION
Audio analysis runs on your device. When iCloud is available, analysis and sections can share through your private iCloud storage while the app is open and the decks are idle. This preparation sync does not upload your audio files.

ACCESS AND PURCHASES
The app includes a 14-day all-access preview. No paid subscription starts automatically. Controller Support, Recording and Open Format have separate monthly and lifetime purchase options. A lifetime All-in-One purchase includes all three. Lifetime purchases also let you use your own DJ name and logo inside the app.

After the preview, free access has performance limits: 20 minutes for controller use, 20 minutes for recording and 70 minutes per set. Reaching a limit does not cut off audio that is already playing. Monthly plans renew until cancelled. Prices appear in the app before purchase.

Use local, unprotected audio files. Protected subscription tracks are not supported.

review.notes:
GenErik DJ uses local, unprotected audio. Import audio from Settings > Library, or permit access to local Music-library tracks. No GenErik DJ account is required. Apple services use the system Apple Account.

The first-launch 14-day preview unlocks the purchase features without starting a subscription. Purchase options and Restore Purchases are in Settings. A compatible controller is optional for on-screen mixing. The controller catalogue lists model-specific coverage.

Audio analysis runs locally. Private iCloud preparation sharing transfers analysis and sections, not audio files. Website: https://dj.generik.au.
